nature: Knowledge extraction and verification gap analysis. No proofs implemented. No consensus/database/wallet/protocol/genesis/PoW/network changes.

honesty_flags.note: Global flags remain false. Five protocol-core files set a LOCAL refinement_proved := true for C++-shaped Coq input records. That is not a C++ source correspondence theorem.

living_lock_vs_stale_docs.historical_verdict_module_count: 196 modules / 167 theorems (historical; do not cite as current)

property_status.res_hard_cap_note: Coq valid_res_cap rejects overshoot on apply_block. C++ ConnectBlock does not reject on a running S_RES scalar; cap is compile-time ResScheduleSum plus per-mint W(h). GetChainResMintTotal is observational.
property_status.note: PARTIALLY_PROVED means Qed about a Coq model and/or finite vectors. It does not mean C++ correspondence.

miner.role: block construction and PoW grind; node CheckProofOfWork is SSOT

recommended_strategy.RATIONALE: Goal A (Coq specification to C++ kernel to binary equivalence) is architecturally blocked: Gallina/OCaml TCB vs C++ SIMD AutoDetect, no CompCert C++ pipeline, Phase-5 DCS_Impossible, and L3 surfaces with no matching L2 types. Goal B isolates consensus-critical C++ (GetRigorPowHash, AssetTypeFromScriptPubKey, VerifyRigorPredicate, W(k), dual-pool CheckTxInputs) and funds local correspondence plus remaining model holes (ASERT, IsResScript vs tag, cm_draw_won, coinbase bind). Keep Path A finite differential gate. Do not flip global honesty flags until a real correspondence theorem exists.
